resources.string: Web navigation. Type a letter in braille. Three fingers up opens help and gestures.
Web navigation\nType a braille letter to jump. Three fingers up opens the menu.
Open a web page that supports navigation by element, then try again.
Unlock the phone to use web navigation. Android 11 or later is required.
Could not open braille web navigation
Choose an element type first. For example, type h for headings.
That letter has no command. Three fingers up opens help.
That gesture has no command. Three fingers up opens the menu.
Enable the CAN Talk braille keyboard in Android settings to write here.
Writing. The braille keyboard is ready. Use Web navigation from its menu to return.
Previous element of the selected type
Next element of the selected type

Use uncontracted braille letters: h headings, k links, l lists, i list items, b buttons, e text fields, f form controls, t tables, g images, d page regions, x checkboxes, c combo boxes, r radio buttons.
Each letter jumps forward. One finger up or down repeats the selected type backward or forward. One finger left or right reads the previous or next item. Two fingers right activates the current element. Finding a text field only reads it; activating it opens writing.
Three fingers up always opens this menu. Two fingers left always closes navigation. Back also closes it. Two fingers down closes it by default. You can assign additional gestures from this menu.
While writing, use Web navigation in the braille keyboard menu to return. Its default shortcut is to hold dots 4, 5 and 6 and swipe left with one finger; you can change it in the keyboard gesture settings.
Perform a swipe for: %1$s. Back cancels. Three fingers up and two fingers left are reserved.
Use a swipe. Braille letters, three fingers up and two fingers left are reserved.
Remove the additional gestures and restore the defaults?
